description: Log redaction (NFR-14), the second line of defence behind logging no free text: quoted text (straight or curly quotes), file paths and file URIs become short keyed hashes, the first 8 hex digits of HMAC-SHA256 of the UTF-8 text under the install's log key. These cases use the fixed test key below. Python's debrief_tools.diagnostics and the extension's diagnostics are both held to them. A Windows or UNC path may have spaces in its folder names, and in its last part when it runs to ': ' or the end of the line, so the rest of such a line is hashed with it.

cases.name: feature names in quotes
cases.line: The plot has no feature 'track-nelson'; refresh and select again.
cases.expected: The plot has no feature '<text:8cc5cb04>'; refresh and select again.

cases.name: apostrophes kept
cases.line: Debrief's tool service can't read the plot 'serial-1'
cases.expected: Debrief's tool service can't read the plot '<text:b8d4440f>'

cases.name: apostrophe inside single quotes
cases.line: no track called 'O'BRIEN' in the plot
cases.expected: no track called '<text:688830e7>' in the plot

cases.name: apostrophe inside double quotes
cases.line: no track called "O'BRIEN" in the plot
cases.expected: no track called "<text:688830e7>" in the plot

cases.name: double quotes
cases.line: Range rings failed: no track called "BLUE ONE"
cases.expected: Range rings failed: no track called "<text:6e0e44c9>"
